name: Hybrid Partitioning Parallel Ray Casting
definition: A parallel volume rendering algorithm for shared-memory MIMD architectures (e.g., SGI Power Challenge) that combines object-based partitioning for boundary cell projection and image-based partitioning for ray traversal to achieve load balancing.
summary: Hybrid Partitioning Parallel Ray Casting is a parallel volume rendering algorithm that combines object-based and image-based partitioning to balance load and avoid replicated ray casting costs.
